proof_body:
by
  intro a b
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hu⟩ ha
    have hx' : a * x = b := hx
    have h1 : x + 1 = x := hu (x + 1) (by
      show a * (x + 1) = b
      rw [ha] at hx' ⊢
      linarith)
    linarith
  · intro ha
    refine ⟨b / a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show a * (b / a) = b
      field_simp
    · intro y hy
      have hy' : a * y = b := hy
      rw [eq_div_iff ha, mul_comm]
      exact hy'
  · intro h
    have h0 := h 0
    have h1 := h 1
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ x
    exact zero_mul x
  · intro h
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
      intro hb
      exact h ⟨0, by rw [ha, hb, zero_mul]⟩
    · exact (h ⟨b / a, by field_simp⟩).elim
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩
    apply hb
    rw [← hx, ha, zero_mul]
